agenda_text:
INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA
  Wednesday, April 8, 2026
  Open Session – 2:00 p.m.

  Web Sites:
  www.cityofinglewood.org/1680/Long-Term-Rentals

  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

The doors to the Council Chamber on the 9th Floor will open at 1:40 p.m. for Open Session. Please be
mindful that seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the Rental Housing Board by sending them to the Rental Housing Board
Secretary at rentalhousingboard@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Rental
Housing Board prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the
meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number and/or subject matter.
Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and
prior to the close of the public hearings will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact
the Office of the Housing Protection Board at (310) 412-4330 with any questions.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities
Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation
thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, or translation services
in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation,
or service by contacting the Housing Protection Department by telephone at 310-412-4330, FAX at 310-412-
4276, One Manchester Boulevard, Suite 602, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to
rentalhousingboard@cityofinglewood.org no later than 48 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS

  1) Receive input from Applicant;
  2) Receive public comments;
  3) Discuss the information provided via submitted petition and comments in deliberation; and
  4) Motion to approve the Rental Housing Board’s decision.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS

  Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Rental Housing Board on any matter connected with the City
  of Inglewood Housing Protection Regulations not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this
  time. Persons with complaints regarding departmental operations are requested to submit those complaints
  first to the Housing Protection Director for resolution.

  CHAIRPERSON AND BOARD MEMBER REMARKS

  ADJOURNMENT INGLEWOOD RENTAL HOUSING BOARD

  In the event that today’s meeting of the Inglewood Rental Housing Board is not held or is concluded prior
  to an agenda item being considered, the agenda item will automatically be continued to the next regularly
  scheduled Rental Housing Board meeting. If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
  or need translation services, please contact the Housing Protection Department at (310) 412-4330 or FAX
  (310) 412-4276, One Manchester Boulevard, Suite 602, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
  requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the scheduled meeting.
